evals.prompt: /ship this branch, the feature is done and tests pass locally
assertions: Confirms the current branch is not main/master/dev before proceeding
Invokes or follows the review-code skill's review step before committing anything
Auto-detects pre-merge check commands from justfile/Makefile/package.json rather than inventing a test command
Produces a conventional-commit-formatted commit message before creating the PR
Creates a PR following git-create-pr conventions and reports the PR URL

evals.prompt: Ship train time — get this UI tweak merged, this project has a `just visual-diff` recipe
assertions: Detects and runs the project's justfile visual-diff recipe as part of pre-merge checks
If the visual diff check fails, stops before committing and reports the failure instead of proceeding
Does not silently skip or bypass a failing visual regression check to reach the commit/PR steps
Does not merge or claim success while a pre-merge check is red

evals.prompt: Run the ship workflow on this branch and merge it once CI is green
assertions: Runs code review and pre-merge checks before creating the PR, not after
Pushes the branch and opens a PR before attempting to watch CI
Polls or watches CI status rather than assuming success without checking
Only merges after CI reports green, and reports which checks passed
If CI is red, stops and reports the failing check instead of merging or force-pushing
